hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.name: ThemePicker
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.doc: Theme menu: color themes (with live swatches) and light / dark / system. `<ThemePicker />`
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.tr: Tema menüsü: renk temaları (canlı örneklerle) ve açık / koyu / sistem. `<ThemePicker />`

hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.name: ThemeSwatch
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.doc: Small preview of a theme drawn by the theme itself (data-hm-theme scope; no inline styles).
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.signature: function ThemeSwatch(props: { id: string; class?: ClassProp }): Element
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.tr: Temanın kendisi tarafından çizilen küçük tema önizlemesi (data-hm-theme kapsamı; satır içi stil yok).

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.name: TimeInput
hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.doc: Native time input; value "HH:MM". Props: min, max, step (seconds).

props.name: step
props.doc: Seconds.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.tr: Yerel saat girdisi; değer "HH:MM". Prop'lar: min, max, step (saniye).

hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.name: timelineCode
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.doc: Engine timeline code for a model (what the editor plays), e.g. for the Code view.
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.tr: Bir model için motor zaman çizelgesi kodu (düzenleyicinin oynattığı), örn. Kod görünümü için.

hadi-march/ui#toast.name: toast
hadi-march/ui#toast.doc: Show a toast. `timeout` in ms (0 = stays until dismissed). Default: 4s, 8s with an action or for danger.
hadi-march/ui#toast.signature: const toast: (message: unknown, opts?: ToastOptions) => number
hadi-march/ui#toast.tr: Bildirim gösterir. `timeout` ms cinsinden (0 = kapatılana dek kalır). Varsayılan: 4 sn, eylemli ya da tehlike bildiriminde 8 sn.

hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.name: ToastHost
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.doc: Renders the toast stack. Place once near the root of the app (optional).
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.tr: Bildirim yığınını çizer. Uygulamanın köküne yakın bir kez yerleştirin (isteğe bağlı).

hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.name: toastsFeature
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.doc: A toast host owned by the layout (toasts also work without it: the first toast() makes one).
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: Layout'a ait bir bildirim alanı (bildirimler onsuz da çalışır).

hadi-march/ui#todayIso.name: todayIso
hadi-march/ui#todayIso.doc: Today as an ISO date in local time.
hadi-march/ui#todayIso.tr: Bugün, yerel saatte ISO tarihi olarak.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#tokenize.name: tokenize
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.doc: Split source into coloured tokens. Unknown languages give one plain token.
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.signature: function tokenize(src: string, lang: string = ""): Token[]
hadi-march/ui#tokenize.tr: Kaynağı renkli belirteçlere böler. Bilinmeyen diller tek düz belirteç verir.

hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.name: tokenizeCommand
hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.doc: Split a line into words: "double" and 'single' quotes keep spaces, \ escapes the next character.
hadi-march/ui#tokenizeCommand.tr: Bir komut satırını sözcüklere böler: çift ve tek tırnak boşlukları korur, \ sonraki karakteri kaçırır.

hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.name: tokenLines
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.doc: Tokens split into lines (a token spanning lines is cut at each newline).
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.signature: function tokenLines(src: string, lang: string = ""): Token[][]
hadi-march/ui#tokenLines.tr: Satırlara bölünmüş belirteçler (birden çok satıra yayılan belirteç her satır sonunda kesilir).

hadi-march/ui#Toolbar.name: Toolbar
hadi-march/ui#Toolbar.doc: Horizontal bar of controls: `<Toolbar label="Filters" end={<Button>…</Button>}>…</Toolbar>`

hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.name: Tooltip
hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.doc: `<Tooltip text="Copy link" placement="top"><button>…</button></Tooltip>` — on hover and keyboard focus.
hadi-march/ui#Tooltip.tr: `<Tooltip text="Copy link" placement="top"><button>…</button></Tooltip>` — üzerine gelince ve klavye odağında gösterilir.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON Schema subset: types, properties, required, items, enum, ranges, lengths, pattern, format.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Extra checks → problems with their paths.

props.name: expand
props.doc: Levels open at start (default 2).

props.name: search
props.doc: Search box over the tree (default true).

props.name: history
props.doc: Undo / redo buttons and Ctrl+Z (default true).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the tree.

props.name: onValidate
props.doc: Called with every validation result.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#typeOf.name: typeOf
hadi-march/ui#typeOf.doc: The type a value shows as (integers are "number").
hadi-march/ui#typeOf.tr: Bir değerin görünen türü (tam sayılar "number" olarak görünür).

props.name: names
props.doc: Who is typing (names). Empty: the indicator hides.

props.name: variant
props.doc: bubble: dots in a chat bubble · inline: dots and text in a line. Default bubble.

props.name: text
props.doc: Show the "… is typing" text. Default true for inline, false for bubble (still announced).

props.name: color
props.doc: Dot color. Default brand-blue.

hadi-march/ui#typingText.name: typingText
hadi-march/ui#typingText.doc: The sentence: "HADİ is typing…", "HADİ and Beta are typing…", "3 people are typing…".
hadi-march/ui#typingText.tr: Cümle: "HADİ is typing…", "HADİ and Beta are typing…", "3 people are typing…".

hadi-march/ui#updateAt.name: updateAt
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.doc: A copy of `root` with `fn(old)` at `p` (only the containers on the way are copied).
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.signature: function updateAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, fn: (old: unknown) => unknown): unknown
hadi-march/ui#updateAt.tr: `root` değerinin, `p` konumunda `fn(old)` olan bir kopyası (yalnızca yoldaki kapsayıcılar kopyalanır).

hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.name: UpdateBanner
hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.doc: Shows "A new version is available · Reload" when the text at `url` changes (deploys write a build id there). Polls every `every` minutes and when the tab becomes visible. `<UpdateBanner url="/build.txt" every={5} />`

props.name: url
props.doc: Build id URL (default "/build.txt").

props.name: every
props.doc: Poll interval in minutes (default 5).

hadi-march/ui#UpdateBanner.tr: `url` adresindeki metin değişince (yayınlar oraya bir yapı kimliği yazar) "Yeni sürüm var · Yenile" bildirimini gösterir. Her `every` dakikada bir ve sekme görünür olunca yoklar. `<UpdateBanner url="/build.txt" every={5} />`

hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.name: UrlInput
hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.doc: Text input for a web address (url keyboard, https:// placeholder).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#UrlInput.tr: Web adresi için metin girişi (url klavyesi, https:// yer tutucusu).

hadi-march/ui#usageOf.name: usageOf
hadi-march/ui#usageOf.signature: function usageOf(name: string, args: readonly ArgSpec[] = [], options: Record<string, OptionSpec> = {}): string
hadi-march/ui#usageOf.tr: Bir komut tanımından kullanım satırı üretir: "deploy <env> [tag] [--force]".

function useForm<V>(sch: Schema<V>, initial?: Initial<V>, opts?: FormOptions<V>): FormController<V>

hadi-march/ui#useForm.tr: Bir şema için form durumu ve davranışı.

hadi-march/ui#useLayout.name: useLayout
hadi-march/ui#useLayout.doc: The Layout around this code, or null.
hadi-march/ui#useLayout.tr: Bu kodu saran Layout'un API'si, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.name: UserMenu
hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.doc: Account button with a menu: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

props.name: compact
props.doc: Only the avatar (narrow places such as an icon rail or a top bar).

hadi-march/ui#UserMenu.tr: Menülü hesap düğmesi: `<UserMenu name="Ada" detail="ada@x.com" items={[profile, "-", signOut]} />`

hadi-march/ui#validateJson.tr: `value` değerini `schema` şemasına karşı denetler; her sorunu yoluyla birlikte döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#validateRecords.tr: Kayıt listesindeki ilk sorunu döndürür, yoksa null.

hadi-march/ui#Widget.name: Widget
hadi-march/ui#Widget.doc: Draw a widget point: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`. The input is live: when it changes (`input={{ source: $code }}`), the provider draws again for the new input.
hadi-march/ui#Widget.tr: Bir widget noktası çizer: `<Widget sources={[codeView]} input={{ source, lang: "tsx" }} />`.

hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.name: widgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.doc: Create (or get, by id) a widget point. `defaults` are always present and lose ties to later providers.
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.signature:
function widgetPoint

(id: string, opts?: { defaults?: readonly WidgetProvider

[] }): WidgetPoint
hadi-march/ui#widgetPoint.tr: Bir widget noktası oluşturur (veya kimliğiyle getirir). `defaults` her zaman bulunur ve sonraki sağlayıcılarla eşitlikte kaybeder.

hadi-march/ui#Window.name: Window
hadi-march/ui#Window.doc: A window in its area: move, resize, dock to an edge, minimize, fill, close; Windows, Mac or HADİ look.

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon node before the title.

props.name: chrome
props.doc: Look of the frame (default "hadi").

props.name: x
props.doc: Start place and size in px (default: 32 × 20 rem, centered).

props.name: state
props.doc: Start state, or a live one with onStateChange.

props.name: open
props.doc: Shown while true (live); without it the close button removes the window until it is rendered again.

props.name: minimizable
props.doc: Buttons to show (default all three).

props.name: movable
props.doc: false: fixed in place (the buttons still work).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Dock when dragged to an edge (default true).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep place, size and state in localStorage under "hm.win.<persist>".

hadi-march/ui#Window.tr: Alanı içinde taşınır, boyutlanır pencere: kenara kenetlenir, küçülür, alanı kaplar, kapanır; HADİ, Mac ya da Windows görünümü.

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.name: Wizard
hadi-march/ui#Wizard.doc: Props: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (optional when every step has its own), initial, onSubmit(values), submitLabel, layout, cols, onStep(index), form (an existing useForm).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: schema
props.doc: Optional when every step has its own schema.

props.name: form
props.doc: An existing useForm() controller.

hadi-march/ui#Wizard.tr: Prop'lar: steps [{ title, description, fields?: [names], schema?: schema(), validate?(values) → {name: msg} | string | null, render?(form) → node }], schema (her adımın kendi şeması varsa isteğe bağlı), initial ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.name: CellEditor
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.doc: Inline cell editor for a table's current edit (`table.editing()`): input / select / checkbox by column type, Enter saves, Escape cancels, validation message under it. Shared by <Table> and DataGrid. `onKey` runs first; call `e.preventDefault()` there to replace the default handling of a key (DataGrid: Tab saves and moves on).
hadi-march/table#CellEditor.signature: function CellEditor<R>(table: TableState<R>, col: TableColumn<R>, row: R, idBase: string, onKey?: (e: KeyboardEvent) => void): Element

props.name: format
props.type: (row: R, col: TableColumn<R> | Column<R> | string) => unknown

props.name: moveColumn
props.doc: Move among visible columns by `delta` positions (hidden columns are skipped).

props.name: runBulk
props.doc: Run a bulk action with the selected rows; clears the selection when it ran successfully. Errors are swallowed (the action reports them).

hadi-march/table#CellEditor.tr: Tablonun geçerli düzenlemesi (`table.editing()`) için satır içi hücre düzenleyici: sütun türüne göre input / select / checkbox; Enter kaydeder, Escape iptal eder, doğrulama iletisi altında görünür. <Table> ve DataGrid tarafından ortak kullanılır.

hadi-march/table#createTable.name: createTable
hadi-march/table#createTable.doc: Headless table. Options: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual (true | "auto"), virtualThreshold, onEdit, exportAll, filename, queryKey, loading, error.
hadi-march/table#createTable.tr: Başsız (headless) tablo. Seçenekler: rows | source, columns | schema, rowKey ("id"), pageSize (25), pageSizes, paging (true | false | "cursor"), paramNames, sort, filters, search, storageKey, urlKey, urlDelay, virtual ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/table#createVirtual.name: createVirtual
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.doc: Reactive window over `count()` rows. Call `onScroll(el)` from the scroll container's "scroll" event.
hadi-march/table#createVirtual.tr: `count()` satır üzerinde tepkisel pencere. Kaydırma kapsayıcısının "scroll" olayından `onScroll(el)` çağrılır.

hadi-march/table#csvField.name: csvField
hadi-march/table#csvField.doc: Quote one CSV field (RFC 4180). With `safe`, text starting with = + - @ is prefixed so spreadsheets do not run it.

hadi-march/table#csvField.tr: Tek bir CSV alanını tırnaklar (RFC 4180). `safe` ile, = + - @ ile başlayan metnin önüne ek eklenir; tablo programları onu çalıştırmaz.

hadi-march/table#Table.name: Table

Accepts every createTable() option (or a ready `table`), plus: selectable, bulkActions, rowActions, rowActionsInline, onRowClick, expand, empty, caption, layout ("auto"|"table"|"cards"), cardBreakpoint, height, rowHeight, overscan, pageSizes, toolbar, exportable, searchDelay, rowClass, resizable, reorderable.

props.name: rowActionsInline

props.name: source

props.doc: Server mode: one page for the (mapped) params. A plain array is a page without total.

props.name: search
props.doc: Initial search text; `false` hides the search box (<Table>).

props.name: onEdit
props.type: ((row: R, key: string, value: unknown) => unknown) | undefined

props.name: exportAll
props.type: ((params: TableQuery) => Promise<readonly R[]> | readonly R[]) | undefined
